contact.contact_note: Route communications to appropriate location/case-type manager; no direct magistrate phone/email, fax or named judicial assistant published on reviewed profile. Case managers not relabeled as assistants.

scheduling.summary: Contact appropriate case manager by phone/email for scheduling; page groups managers by location and family/civil/probate work.

communications.summary: Case-manager communications limited to scheduling or proposed recommendation/report questions; copy all parties/counsel and avoid substantive ex parte contact.

proposed_orders.summary: Word proposed recommended orders/reports through Portal proposed-order section, shared with other parties, cover letter indicating agreement/disagreement. Submit within five days after hearing unless instructed otherwise.

courtesy_copies.summary: PDF/A courtesy materials emailed to appropriate manager five days before hearing/trial. Section C separately requires exhibit copies/lists to manager and hard copies to clerk five business days ahead; retain distinction.

remote_appearance.summary: Page generally schedules UMC, child-support calendar and hearings under two hours by Zoom, plus hearings granted by motion. ID98914856399, no passcode; join ten minutes early. Audio-only not allowed for final/evidentiary hearings; page states Zoom hearings audio-recorded.

conferral.summary: Proposed reports/orders shared with parties and cover letter identifies agreement/disagreement; no general motion conferral instruction stated.

noncivil_basic_operations.summary: Family/probate/mental-health responsibilities retained with basic shared operations; no substantive specialized review.
